mechanism_read: The tokenized observation autoencoder is stable on encoded ground-truth surfaces.
The sampled latent transition leaves the learned latent manifold immediately.
Decoder outputs from off-manifold token states create floor/ceiling explosions, over-common-mode dependence, and the wrong mean-reversion sign.

decision.next_step: Move to a probabilistic latent-token state-space family instead of adding deterministic token-delta stabilizers.
